groups.defect: isTeamAdminOrOwner combines isTeamAdmin and isTeamOwner with && instead of ||, so the user has to hold both roles.
groups.rationale: All five point at lines 46-48 and ask for the same && to || change.

groups.defect: The blacklist and existing-attendee checks compare guest emails case-sensitively against lowercased or stored values, so different casing gets past both.
groups.rationale: All three cover the same filter at lines 70-82, and the fix is the same: lowercase both sides.

groups.defect: sendAddGuestsEmails gets the raw guests array instead of the filtered uniqueGuests, so the wrong email template is picked.
groups.rationale: All four say to pass uniqueGuests instead of guests at the sendAddGuestsEmails call.

groups.defect: The server-side ZAddGuestsInputSchema doesn't check that emails are unique, which the client dialog does check.
groups.rationale: Both ask for the same uniqueness refine in addGuests.schema.ts.

partialOverlap.rationale: s_9d50fd99 mainly reports the unfiltered guests passed to the email sender. It also says the server schema doesn't enforce uniqueness, which is the defect in s_d5ce31d3.
